import numpy as np
import scipy
from scipy import optimize

def load_data(filename):
    with open(filename) as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    numbers = []
    for line in lines[1:]:
        parts = line.strip().split(',')
        for part in parts:
            nums = part.split()
            if nums:
                numbers.append(float(nums[0]))
                if len(nums) > 1:
                    numbers.append(float(nums[1]))
    if len(numbers) % 2 != 0:
        numbers = numbers[:-1]
    x = numbers[::2]
    y = numbers[1::2]
